splash.subtitle: a quiet story you can take your time with

intro.slide0a: You are a professor at an elite university. Students love you, colleagues respect you, and you enjoy your subject.
intro.slide0b: But everyone reaches a moment when it's time to write a book that makes sense of your experience—to articulate your theories more clearly. That moment has come for you. You've taken a sabbatical: a paid year off to write your book.
intro.slide1a: Over the summer you wrapped up your obligations and rented a house on a remote island so nothing would distract you from writing. Maybe even two books—who knows.
intro.slide1b: And now, having gathered everything you need—your laptop, plenty of paper, and the rest—you're riding a small boat to the home that will be yours for the next year. The landlord is supposed to meet you at the dock and show you around.
